items.name: Warm Up Vancouver 2025

venue.name: Hilton Vancouver Airport
venue.address: 5911 Minoru Blvd, Richmond, British Columbia, V6X 4C7, Canada

items.information:
We are excited to announce Warm Up Vancouver 2025! This official WCA competition will take place less than three weeks before the 2025 World Championship in Seattle.

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWh2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f989abe60a5b9303f42de97dee94ad812338f4b3/image.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/en)

**Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in-case.

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).

**Notice of filming and photography**: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Masks will be optional. Do not attend if you feel/are sick.

venue.name: Welshpool Landing
venue.address: 11 Welshpool Wharf Rd, Welshpool, Campobello Island N.B. E5E 1G1

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. 

Since this is a "Favorites" competition, you may choose at most four (4) events.

You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the What is a Favorites Competition?, Competitor List and Waiting List sectionsat the top of this page for more details.

items.name: SM Manila Speedcubing Warm-Up 2025

venue.name: SM City Manila
venue.address: HXRM+4G2, Natividad Almeda-Lopez corner A. Villegas and, San Marcelino St, Ermita, Manila, Metro Manila

items.information:
Welcome to **SM Manila Speedcubing Warm-up 2025**! This competition features the events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5 3x3 One-handed, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-blind, and Clock with 3x3 as the main event.
​
We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.
​
This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences.
